subject: Request: personnel evidence sample & leaver matrix for SOC 2 review
messages:
From: Susan Lam <susan.lam@clearstream.com>
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: Veritas Assure <auditor@veritas-assure.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC 2 sampling request — personnel onboarding/offboarding evidence

Hi Rafael,

As part of our SOC 2 scoping we need a small sample of personnel evidence related to onboarding, background checks, recurring security training, and offboarding. Specifically the auditor asked for: 1) a roster with training completion timestamps for a 20-person sample, 2) redacted background-check confirmations for hires in the last 24 months, and 3) a leaver/timeline matrix showing access removal dates and deprovisioning artifacts for three recent terminations.

Can you confirm whether you can deliver these items (redacted as needed) and an estimated delivery date? If you have a standard evidence bundle or a drive folder we can use, please share.

Thanks,
Susan Lam
Security Compliance Manager
ClearStream Security
From: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
To: Susan Lam <susan.lam@clearstream.com>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai, Veritas Assure <auditor@veritas-assure.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 sampling request — personnel onboarding/offboarding evidence

Hi Susan — thanks for the clear ask. We can provide the artifacts you listed. Tentative plan:

- Marissa will assemble a 20-person training roster with completion timestamps and export as CSV (redacted PII).
- Kimberly will pull the background-check confirmations and redact to the minimum identifiers required by Veritas.
- Jonas will produce a leaver timeline matrix (access removal dates, ticket IDs, and proof-of-deprovision).

Target delivery: EOD Monday (2026-09-20). If the auditor needs anything sooner or a different sample frame (e.g., only US hires), call it out and we’ll adjust.

I’ll coordinate and upload to a secure Drive folder and share a DocuSign link for chain-of-custody where required.

Best,
Rafael Mendes
Head of Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference
From: marissa_cole@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 sampling request — personnel onboarding/offboarding evidence

Rafael — starting the roster build. Notes:

- I will pull training completion from the LMS (quarterly security module + phishing microlearning). Export will include: employee_id (pseudonymized), hire_date, training_module, completion_timestamp, reassign_flag.
- For the 20-person sample I propose: 8 hires in the last 6 months, 8 hires 6–18 months, 4 hires >18 months to cover retention behavior.
- Attachment: onboarding-training-roster-2026-Q2.csv (redacted column headers).

One question: does Veritas need the original LMS audit log entries or is a redacted CSV sufficient for sampling?

Marissa Cole
Security Operations Program Manager
Redwood Inference
From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, rafael_mendes@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 17 Sep 2026 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SOC 2 sampling request — personnel onboarding/offboarding evidence

Following up with the background-checks plan:

- Vendor: ClearHire (contracted vendor) — we will provide confirmation letters and redacted verification stamps (no SSNs, DOBs will be year-only where required).
- Attachment: bg-check-summary-redacted-2026.pdf (contains sample confirmation stamps and vendor contact).
- Retention note: our policy retains background-check proof for 5 years; we can confirm whether any of the hires in the sample fall outside that window.

Jonas — I need the deprovision ticket IDs and timestamps for the three leavers to populate the leaver matrix. Rafael — please confirm you are OK with us including ticket links (internal Jira) as evidence or if the auditor prefers exported snapshots only.

Kimberly Park
Senior HR Operations Manager
Redwood Inference
From: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
To: rafael_mendes@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai, Veritas Assure <auditor@veritas-assure.com>, Susan Lam <susan.lam@clearstream.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Sep 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Delivery: personnel evidence sample + leaver matrix (Drive link attached)

Team — final delivery. Actions completed:

1) Uploaded folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cExEvidencePack (shared with auditor and ClearStream view-only). Contents: onboarding-training-roster-2026-Q2.csv, bg-check-summary-redacted-2026.pdf, leaver-timeline-matrix-2024-2026.xlsx, training-policy-v2.1.pdf.

2) Leaver matrix includes: employee pseudonym, termination_date, deprovision_ticket_id, access_removal_timestamp, artifact_reference (screenshot or exported log). We redacted PII but included sufficient metadata for traceability.

3) DocuSign room opened for chain-of-custody acceptance: https://app.docusign.com/rooms/DocRoom-987654. Rafael — please advise if Veritas wants a signed evidence receipt or an acknowledgement email is sufficient.

If auditors need additional fields (e.g., original LMS audit log lines), we can deliver a protected export under NDA. Thanks all for quick turnaround.

Jonas Weber
IT Asset & Access Controls Lead
Redwood Inference
